accusations.text: I don't trust {name}.
{name} has been very quiet…
Has anyone else noticed {name} dodging every question?
My gut says {name}.
{name} answered way too fast. Suspicious.
Why is {name} so calm right now?
I'm watching you, {name}.
{name} keeps changing the subject.
Look at {name}'s face. That's a guilty face.
{name} was first to point fingers. Classic move.
I think {name} is {aWolf}. Call it a hunch.
{name}, where were you last night?
Something about {name} doesn't add up.
{name} is being too helpful. That's what I'd do.
Vote {name}. Trust me on this one.
{name} hasn't accused anyone yet. Why not?
I saw {name} smile when the news came in.
{name} agrees with everyone. Nobody agrees with everyone.
If I had to bet, I'd bet on {name}.
{name} is way too relaxed for someone in danger.
Let's hear {name} explain themselves.
{name} voted weird yesterday. Just saying.
Every time {name} talks, someone ends up in trouble.
{name} is trying very hard to look innocent.
Not saying it's {name}… but it's probably {name}.
{name} has a plan, and I don't like it.
Keep an eye on {name}. Both eyes, actually.
{name} knows more than they're telling us.
I'd feel safer with {name} out of the game.
{name}'s story changes every day.
Did {name} just sigh? That was a guilty sigh.
{name} is the only one not worried. Think about it.
My vote is on {name} unless someone convinces me.
{name} protected the wrong person in the argument.
I've got a bad feeling about {name}.
{name} keeps looking at the door.
Who's with me on {name}?
{name} was suspiciously sleepy this morning.
Everything points to {name}. Everything.
{name} is too quiet, and quiet is how {wolves} win.

defences.text: I'm just a {villager}, I swear!
Me? I've been helping this whole time!
If you vote me out, you're wasting a vote.
I'm innocent! Look somewhere else.
Why would I accuse people if I were guilty?
Wrong person. I promise you, wrong person.
I've got nothing to hide. Ask me anything.
That's exactly what {wolves} want you to think.
Check my votes. I've been on the right side.
I'm the most harmless person here!
Accusing me is a great way to lose this game.
I slept all night. Honestly. Like a baby.
You've got the wrong idea about me.
Pick me and you'll regret it tomorrow.
I'm on your side! Why is nobody listening?
Look at who's accusing me. Now that's suspicious.
I'd never! Well, not tonight anyway.
I'm just a humble {villager} trying to survive.
Save your vote for someone who deserves it.
Hand on heart: not me.

seerClaims.text: Okay, cards on the table: I'm the {seer}, and it's {name}.
I checked {name} last night. {aWolf}, for sure.
{seer} here. Vote {name}. I know what I saw.
I'm risking everything: I'm the {seer}. {name} is guilty.
Trust me, I'm the {seer}. {name} is one of {wolves}.
I didn't want to say it, but I'm the {seer}. It's {name}.
I looked into {name}. They're {aWolf}. Vote now!
I'm the {seer}, and {name} is not who they say they are.

lastWords.text: You'll miss me when I'm gone.
Remember me fondly. And vote smarter.
I told you so. Well, I'm telling you now.
Good luck, everyone. You'll need it.
Watch the quiet ones. That's all I'll say.
Well, that was fun while it lasted.
Tell my story at the next party.
Goodbye, cruel village! I mean town. Whatever.

generic.text: Let's think before we vote this time.
We need to talk about last night.
Nobody panic. Let's go person by person.
Whoever it is, they're good at this.
I have a theory, but I need more proof.
Somebody here is lying, and it's not me.
Stay sharp. They'll strike again tonight.
